title: The Brew Shop Beer Advent Calendar (Pre-Order Only!)
contentHtml:
It's never too early to prepare for the holiday season! We're excited to bring back The Brew Shop Beer Advent Calendar! Inside our festive box, you'll find 24 beers to carry you through the first 24 days of December. Available in limited quantities and by pre-order only, make sure you grab your box before they sell out!

Our Beer Advent Calendar will be hand-selected by your favorite beer nerds (Beth, Julie & Aidan) and filled with our latest favorites and seasonal treats. What's inside is a surprise, but expect the following: each box will contain EIGHT holiday beers, EIGHT special releases, and EIGHT shop favorites. Our holiday elves will wrap each box and number each can with all the merriment washi tape can provide!

This year's lineup will be different than last year's, but to give you an idea of what to expect, breweries included in the 2025 Brew Shop Advent Calendar included brews from: Ocelot, Wheatland Spring, Forest & Main, Schilling, Parish, The Veil, Bluejacket, Halfway Crooks, Adroit Theory, and many, many more!

Beer Advent Calendars will be available for pick-up beginning Friday, November 20.
